Body.Content:
This update provides fixes and download links to the latest versions of these Site Recovery components:

  • Site Recovery Unified Setup and Site Recovery Mobility agent (both version 9.30.5407.1) for Windows Server, CentOS, and Ubuntu machines. Used for Azure virtual machine (VM) replication, and replication of on-premises VMware VMs and physical servers to Azure.
  • Site Recovery configuration server OVF template (version 5.1.5200.0). Used for replication of on-premises VMware VMs and physical servers to Azure.
  • Site Recovery Provider (version 5.1.5200). Used for replication of Hyper-V VMs to Azure.
  • Recovery Services agent (version 2.0.9165.0). Used for replication of Hyper-V VMs to Azure.

Read more information.
